_readme: Verified rulings on flags raised by storage-reconcile.mjs (audit item 6.1, tier 1).
The tool classifies structurally; a human read decides. Anything ruled here keeps its
ruling on re-run, so a later pass argues only about what is genuinely new.
ruling: 'benign' (flag is correct but not a defect) | 'defect' (confirmed) | 'scope'
(the tool cannot see the other side of a boundary).

jp-study.blanc.toolbox.workspaces.v1.why: Workspace-launcher is retired in favour of the App Drawer. BlancReadyToolPanels.tsx:1551-1554 documents that the App Drawer migration reads this key non-destructively and never writes it again. A migration inbox that predates the LEGACY_ naming convention.

jp-novels-planned.why: Read once and removeItem-ed in the same effect (NovelsContent.tsx:365,374), migrating planned ids into store.plan. A consumed-once inbox.

jp-study-whisper-lang.why: setStudyLang writes it beside STUDY_LANG_KEY (studyEnvironment.ts:40-41) and nothing reads it. Its only other mention is settingsCatalog.ts:180, which lists it for byte accounting, not as a functional read. Behaviour comes from setWhisperModelTier instead. Same shape as audit item 3.3.

sea-server-auth-token.why: Written by seanimeBootstrap.ts:26 and read by the vendored Seanime frontend at vendor/seanime-web/app/(main)/_atoms/server-status.atoms.ts:11 via atomWithStorage. The census scans src/ only, so a key handed across that boundary always looks write-only.

noctis-session-queue-v2.why: Declared in the sibling project jp-study-app-noctis-beta (src/renderer/cityPagesQueue.ts:7), not in this repo. A different build of the app writes into the same Chromium profile origin.

noctis-pages-queue-v1.why: Same as noctis-session-queue-v2 — owned by the jp-study-app-noctis-beta build sharing this profile origin.
